about.subtitle: Meet the Bride & Groom
about.title: About Parima & Jinkawin
about.welcome: Welcome! Whether you are here from the Groom’s or Bride’s family & friends, here is a little glimpse into who we are and our journey together.

bride.name: Parima S. (Pang)
bride.parentsText: Daughter of Somchai & Wanida S., raised in Bangkok with a love for arts and family gatherings.
bride.hobbiesText: Baking sourdough, botanical watercolor painting, and discovering hidden café gems across Thailand.
bride.quoteText: “Parima brings warmth and laughter to every room she enters. Her kindness and endless thoughtfulness make me want to be a better person every day.”

groom.name: Jinkawin P. (Win)
groom.parentsText: Son of Prasert & Chintana P., known for his helpful nature and love for technology.
groom.hobbiesText: Landscape photography, mechanical keyboards, hiking mountain trails, and brewing espresso.
groom.quoteText: “Jinkawin is my steady anchor. He is patient, incredibly funny when you get to know him, and always knows how to brighten my day.”

story.title: How We Met & Fun Q&A
story.firstMetText: At a cozy café in Ari, Bangkok in 2021 over cold brew coffee.
story.proposalText: During a sunset walk along the Chiang Mai mountain view in late 2024.
story.sharedDreamText: Building a home filled with art, travel memories, and family warmth.
story.q1: Q: Who made the first move?
story.a1: Jinkawin! He asked Parima if she wanted to explore a photography exhibition together.
story.q2: Q: Who is the better cook?
story.a2: Parima masters all desserts & pastries, while Jinkawin handles savory weekend pastas!
story.a3: Exploring the historic streets of Kyoto during autumn foliage season.
story.a4: Making hand-poured pour-over coffee together every Sunday morning.
